groups.note: beaded chain looped around the ankle/instep (~x 508-555, y 1395-1430) with the hanging diamond-shaped crystal drop at the front (~x 528-540, y 1425-1458); soft bead chain and swinging rigid pendant move with different rhythms, and the chain wraps around the ankle needing front/back interleave

parts.name: front_chain
parts.note: visible V-shaped bead chain on the front of the ankle (~x 509-556, y 1376-1407), from the larger side end beads at both ankle edges (~y 1381) down to the center bead; soft strand that sags and sways with the pendant weight and draws in front of the shin/foot, controlled as one bead string

parts.name: back_chain
parts.note: inferred rear arc of the chain passing behind the ankle (~x 510-556, y 1370-1381), joining both side end beads of the front chain; hidden by the leg and drawn behind it, separated from the front chain for the front/back interleave around the ankle

parts.name: center_bead
parts.note: round white bead at the V apex of the chain (~x 529-537, y 1404-1412) that links the chain to the pendant; acts as the pendant's pivot, kept separate so the drop can swing around it

parts.name: crystal_drop
parts.note: rigid diamond-shaped blue crystal hanging below the center bead (~x 529-538, y 1412-1434); swings as a pendulum with its own rhythm from the bead pivot, one rigid unit

groups.note: character's left leg (image right), bare, from the hip joint cap hidden under the pelvis through thigh, knee, shin, ankle to the bare foot with toes, plus the beaded anklet with crystal drop worn on the ankle/instep; thigh, shin and foot bend separately and the anklet chain and pendant swing on the foot

parts.name: left_thigh
parts.note: thigh from the hip joint cap hidden under the pelvis (top ~y 704, x ~509-626) down through the inner-thigh contact zone (x ~506) to the top of the knee (~y 1130); bends at the hip as one unit

parts.name: left_shin
parts.note: knee cap and lower leg from the knee (~y 1040, overlapping the thigh bottom for the bend) through calf and shin to the ankle (~y 1405, overlapping the foot top); bends at the knee as one unit

groups.note: both legs from thighs to bare feet, including the beaded anklets
